Añade el arroz y remueve 2 minutos, sepa: Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes, breaking it up with the spoon if it has clumped together.
Añade el atún cuando las claras estén a: Add the tuna when the whites are half set and still glossy, and fold it in gently.
Añade el brócoli en ramilletes a la MISM: Add the broccoli florets to the SAME pot for the last 4 minutes. One less pan to wash and the result is identical.
Añade el brócoli en ramilletes al colado: Add the broccoli florets to the steamer for the last 5 minutes.
Añade el brócoli escurrido y saltea 2 mi: Add the drained broccoli and fry for 2 minutes; then the noodles with a splash of water or soy sauce.
Añade el brócoli y el trigo sarraceno co: Add the broccoli and the buckwheat with a splash of water, fry for 2 minutes. Separate the grains with a fork.
Añade el cacao en polvo ANTES que el plá: Add the cocoa powder BEFORE the banana and stir until there are no dry lumps left: tipped over the fruit it just floats as powder and never blends in.
Añade el edamame congelado en los último: Add the frozen edamame for the last 5 minutes, in the same steamer.
Añade el huevo, el pavo y el tomate en d: Add the egg, the turkey and the diced tomato, fold both sides in and roll it up from the bottom, pressing lightly.
Añade el jamón cocido en tiras y remueve: Add the cooked ham in strips and stir for 1 minute, just to warm it through. Fry it and it turns leathery.
Añade el jamón en tiras y remueve 30 seg: Add the ham in strips and stir for 30 seconds.
Añade el maíz escurrido y el arroz integ: Add the drained sweetcorn and the brown rice and fry for 2 minutes, so everything comes to the same temperature.
Añade el pan integral en trozos y remuev: Add the wholemeal bread in pieces and stir for 1 minute so it soaks up the oil.
Añade el pavo cortado en tiras cuando el: Add the turkey cut into strips when the egg is half set and still glossy.
Añade el pavo en lonchas cortado en tira: Add the sliced turkey cut into strips, 1 minute just to warm it through.
Añade el plátano en trozos y la avena. T: Add the banana in pieces and the oats. Put the lid on before you turn it on.
Añade el plátano en trozos, la avena y l: Add the banana in pieces, the oats and the peanut butter.
Añade el plátano en trozos. Tapa SIEMPRE: Add the banana in pieces. ALWAYS put the lid on before you turn it on.
Añade el tomate en dados y deja 2 minuto: Add the diced tomato and give it 2 minutes more, until it too has lost its juice. Tip everything onto a plate.
Añade el tomate en dados y deja que se d: Add the diced tomato and let it break down for 4-5 minutes over a medium heat, crushing it with the spoon.
Añade el tomate en dados, 2 minutos, y l: Add the diced tomato, 2 minutes, then the spinach: it wilts in 30 seconds in the heat.
Añade el tomate troceado y deja 3 minuto: Add the chopped tomato and give it 3 minutes over a medium heat until it breaks down.
Añade el tomate troceado y deja 8 minuto: Add the chopped tomato and give it 8 minutes over a medium-low heat. The longer it goes, the better the sauce; it is the one ingredient that genuinely improves with waiting.
Añade el tomate troceado y el jamón serr: Add the chopped tomato and the jamón serrano in strips, and give it 10 minutes until it becomes a thick sauce.
Añade el tomate troceado y una pizca de: Add the chopped tomato and a pinch of salt, and give it 15 minutes over a medium-low heat, stirring now and then, until it is a thick sauce with no loose liquid.
Añade el tomate y deja 4 minutos, aplast: Add the tomato and give it 4 minutes, crushing it with the spoon until it becomes a thick sauce.
Añade el tomate y remueve con cuidado, s: Add the tomato and stir carefully, without crushing it.
Añade el trigo sarraceno con un chorrito: Add the buckwheat with a splash of water, warm it for 2 minutes and SEPARATE IT WITH A FORK, without mashing: stirred hot with a spoon it packs into a lump.
Añade la caballa desmigada y mezcla con: Add the flaked mackerel and fold it in gently so it does not turn to mush.
Añade la canela fuera del fuego. Media c: Add the cinnamon off the heat. Half a teaspoon is enough.
Añade la coliflor y saltea 2 minutos par: Add the cauliflower and fry for 2 minutes to pick up a little colour.
Add the cauliflower and fry for 2 minutes to pick up some colour.
AÑADE LA GRANOLA JUSTO ANTES DE COMER, n: ADD THE GRANOLA JUST BEFORE EATING, not sooner: once it touches the yoghurt it softens within minutes and loses its crunch.
AÑADE LA GRANOLA JUSTO ANTES DE COMER: e: ADD THE GRANOLA JUST BEFORE EATING: once it touches liquid it softens within minutes.
Añade la mermelada en puntos por encima: Dot the jam over the top rather than spreading it in a layer: that way every bite gets some and it does not soak the whole slice.
Dot the jam over the top rather than spreading it: that way every bite gets some and the whole cake does not go soggy.
Añade la pasta ya cocida con dos cuchara: Add the cooked pasta with two tablespoons of water and stir for 1 minute to bring everything together.
Añade la patata cocida en dados y saltea: Add the boiled potato in cubes and fry for 3 minutes more so it takes on colour and mingles with the garlic.
Añade la salsa y remueve 1 minuto: espes: Add the sauce and stir for 1 minute: it thickens by itself and clings to the chicken in a glaze.
Añade la zanahoria en rodajas finas y sa: Add the carrot in thin rounds and fry for 5 minutes in that fat.
Add the carrot in thin rounds and fry for 5 minutes: cut thick it will not cook in this time and stays raw.
Add the carrot in thin rounds and fry for 5 minutes: the thinner it is, the sooner it cooks.
Añade la zanahoria en rodajas y un vaso: Add the carrot in rounds and a glass of water, and scrape the bottom with the spoon to lift the browned bits.
Añade la zanahoria escurrida, mezcla y s: Add the drained carrot, mix, and serve over the hot brown rice.
Añade las espinacas alrededor el último: Add the spinach around the edges for the last minute, until it wilts. Parsley if you have some.
Añade las espinacas y remueve 1 minuto,: Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute, until it wilts.
Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute, only until it wilts.
Añade las espinacas y remueve 30 segundo: Add the spinach and stir for 30 seconds, only until it starts to wilt without collapsing.
Añade las espinacas y remueve hasta que: Add the spinach and stir until it wilts, 1 minute.
Añade las espinacas y una pizca de sal,: Add the spinach and a pinch of salt, and stir for 30 seconds: it wilts on its own from the heat of the meat and the pan.
Añade las lentejas escurridas y el arroz: Add the drained lentils and the rice, stir and warm for 3 minutes more. Stir little and gently: tinned lentils fall apart very quickly.
Añade las lentejas y calienta 3 minutos: Add the lentils and warm for 3 minutes over a low heat, STIRRING AS LITTLE AS POSSIBLE or they turn to purée. Then the pasta with two tablespoons of water.
Add the lentils and warm for 3 minutes over a low heat. STIR AS LITTLE AS POSSIBLE: the tinned ones are already cooked and collapse into purée if you work them.
Añade las lentejas y calienta 3 minutos,: Add the lentils and warm for 3 minutes, stirring as little as you can so they do not break up.
Añade las lentejas y calienta 5 minutos: Add the lentils and warm for 5 minutes more. Do not let it boil hard: at a rolling boil tinned lentils fall apart and the soup turns to purée.
Añade las lentejas, calienta 3 minutos y: Add the lentils, warm for 3 minutes and take it off the heat.
Add the sardines on top in pieces. Lemon and pepper.
Añade las verduras congeladas SIN descon: Add the frozen vegetables STILL FROZEN and fry for 4 minutes more over a high heat. Thawing them first leaves them soggy.
Añade las verduras congeladas y saltea 4: Add the frozen vegetables and fry for 4 minutes. Then half a glass of water with a tablespoon of tomato sauce or soy sauce, and let the tofu SOAK IT UP for 4 minutes, shaking the pan rather than stirring.
Añade las verduras congeladas y saltea 5: Add the frozen vegetables and fry for 5 minutes more, until their water has evaporated.
Añade los frutos rojos con el jugo que h: Add the berries along with any juice they have released: that juice sweetens the yoghurt and should not be thrown away.
Add the berries along with any juice they have released. A drizzle of honey if you want it sweeter.
Añade los frutos rojos con su jugo y las: Add the berries with their juice and the almonds. A drizzle of honey if you want it sweeter.
Add the berries with their juice.
Añade los frutos rojos por encima y mézc: Add the berries on top and stir them through if you like the colour running into it.
Añade los garbanzos escurridos y saltea: Add the drained chickpeas and fry for 3 minutes, stirring gently, so they warm through without breaking up.
Añade los garbanzos y deja 5 minutos a f: Add the chickpeas and give them 5 minutes over a low heat.
Añade los garbanzos y medio vaso de agua: Add the chickpeas and half a glass of water, and give it 5 minutes over a medium-low heat. Tinned chickpeas are already tender: they are only taking on flavour, they do not need further cooking.
Añade los garbanzos y un cucharón del ag: Add the chickpeas and a ladle of the cooking water, and give it 3 minutes over a medium heat to bring it together.
Añade un diente de ajo picado y una cuch: Add a chopped clove of garlic and a teaspoon of paprika, stir for 20 seconds OFF the heat (paprika burns in no time) and go back on the heat.
Añádela al final y mezcla. Cortada con a: Add it at the end and mix. Cut in advance it oxidises and goes brown.
Añádelas al final para que no se humedez: Add them at the end so they do not go soft against the ricotta.
Add them on top with their juice.
Antes de escurrir, guarda medio vaso del: Before draining, save half a glass of the cooking water.
